title: Internal-network backend deployment foundation
intent: Provide the smallest secure, reproducible backend bundle for internal deployment before frontend wiring or local-model verification.

requirements.title: Backend foundation and internal deployment
requirements.description: Create FastAPI settings, health/readiness, database/session/migrations, cookie JWT auth, roles, seed, Compose and deterministic backend verification with a stable domain-router seam for later stages.

constraints: Cookie state changes require CSRF/origin checks.
The target is an internal network; no public model endpoint is required.
Course CI and deploy files remain untouched.
Later domain stages consume the app/router seam and do not rewrite its ownership.
